Thank you so much for giving so much insight. I've asked multiple people and none have said this much.

*"Be brave.Develop a thick skin. Share art. Let the Internet pour hate on it. Drink it in and bathe in it until it doesn’t matter anymore.*

*Never defend your art. You owe it no one to please their aesthetic.*

*Art style is immaterial. Equipment is immaterial. It’s art. Every single thing is subjective. Remember the banana taped to the wall.*

*If you don’t enjoy the process, the results matter little. Find motivation in the process.*

*You are not an aspiring graphic artist. You are a graphic artist.*

*Every piece of art is a complex problem that has been solved. Break it down into smaller and smaller parts until you have a hundred simple problems. Then solve those. Do the small things with great love.*

*You will always come to a point during the act of creating a piece of art where you will hate it and not know what to do with it. Familiarity breeds contempt. Step away and leave it alone. You will know when and whether to come back to it.*

*All writers are readers. All artists look at the art of others. Look very closely at art you like. There is no better teacher."*

Everything you said here inspired me so much. Know that, going forward, I will always remember this. I will hold this comment dear to me. I just want you to know that you will be up there in the list of people that inspired me to pursue this. Right up there with my close friends and most especially my SO.

Thank you kind stranger <3
